prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in serious personal injuries to our client. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits for the insured driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any other coverage information that may apply to this claim. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, adjuster notes, recorded statements, vehicle repair and total loss records, telematics or event data, surveillance footage, and any communications with the insured or other parties. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
